lines: You hear the same apology often.
It feels like a gentle bandage.
But words alone cannot heal wounds.
Because the apology stops short of action.
You may start to doubt your worth.
Respect grows when you set clear limits.
Your peace lives where apologies match change.
Follow for honest insights on healthy boundaries.
cta: Follow for honest insights on healthy boundaries.
caption: Apologies mean little without real change. Save this reminder to protect your peace.
